package.name: robot_firmware
package.description: Arduino Mega 2560 firmware for the OfficeMate hardware hub: motor driver (4WD skid-steer via 2x L298N), MPU6050 IMU, HC-SR04 ultrasonic, INA219 battery monitor, MFRC522 RFID, compartment IR, SG90 door servos and a 20x4 I2C LCD. Flashed to the board; the ROS-side peer that talks to it over USB-serial is the hardware_bridge package. Includes flash_firmware.sh, a one-command compile+upload helper built on arduino-cli.
